semantics.rust_signature: fn cast_to_input_with_context_exact_native(backend: &CpuBackend, weight: &Tensor, input: &Tensor, non_blocking: bool, copy: bool, context: &ExecutionContext<'_>) -> Result<Tensor, OperatorIndirectionError>
semantics.mutation_rule: both inputs remain immutable and only a complete converted tensor is published
semantics.alias_rule: delegates copy and same-dtype/device identity exactly to cast_to_exact_native
semantics.shape_rule: preserves weight rank, dimensions, and logical element order
semantics.dtype_rule: destination dtype and device are taken exactly from input
semantics.layout_rule: logical strided weights are accepted and converted output is contiguous
semantics.device_rule: CPU ordinal zero is exact native; uncertified input devices return typed unavailable
semantics.numeric_rule: all scalar conversion behavior is owned by canonical DType codecs
semantics.tolerance: bit-exact when representable and canonical narrowing otherwise
semantics.cancellation_points: before delegation, at bounded cast elements, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: inherits floating-cast identity semantics from cast_to_exact_native
semantics.jvp_rule: inherits floating tangent conversion from cast_to_exact_native
